integrity.classification_basis: Primary subject is exact convex conductance allocation and budget optimization (MSC2020 90C25), with graph spectra supporting the optimization.
integrity.mathematical_basis: Full unrestricted strict convexity; exact eigenvalue reduction; exact Fourier resolvent and uniform compact scaling proof.
integrity.verification: Standalone executable code produced 57 successful grouped checks; these finite checks are not a proof of the asymptotic limit.

scientific_limitations: Only undirected prisms with equal prices within the ring-edge and rung-edge classes; prices and budget fixed in the large-size limit.
Related 2017 prism source inspected at abstract level only, leaving a specialized historical-priority risk.
No independent mathematical audit or external validation has been performed.
title: Mesoscopic rung allocation in resistance-optimal prism networks
